runSetup.name: CalendarEventsBetweenCallbacksForInteractiveRun
runSetup.description: The number of calendar events between callbacks for an interactive run.

runSetup.name: DisableRandomness
runSetup.description: Whether to disable random number generation during the run.

runSetup.name: EndTime
runSetup.description: The ending time of the simulation when RunEndType is EndingTime. For an infinite run, set RunEndType to Infinite.

runSetup.name: EndTimeUnitSubType
runSetup.description: The display unit subtype used to present EndTimeValue.

runSetup.name: EndTimeValue
runSetup.description: The run length in EndTimeUnitSubType units when RunEndType is RunLength.

runSetup.name: ExhaustiveConstraintChecking
runSetup.description: Whether to perform exhaustive constraint checking.

runSetup.name: FrameInterval
runSetup.description: The animation frame interval in simulation hours.

runSetup.name: FreezePeriodHours
runSetup.description: The time offset into the simulation at which statistics will be reset, in hours. Use zero for no warmup period.

runSetup.name: GenerateNeuralNetworkTrainingDataReplicationNumber
runSetup.description: The replication number used for random sampling when generating neural network training data.

runSetup.name: GenerateProfileReport
runSetup.description: Whether to generate a profile report for the run.

runSetup.name: Latitude
runSetup.description: The model latitude used for location-dependent behavior.

runSetup.name: LoadAction
runSetup.description: The action to take when the model is loaded.

allowedValueDescriptions.description: Do not perform an action after loading.
Reset the model after loading.
Step the model after loading.
Run the model after loading.
Fast-forward the model after loading.

runSetup.name: LogInteractiveRuntimeData
runSetup.description: Whether to log interactive runtime data.

runSetup.name: Longitude
runSetup.description: The model longitude used for location-dependent behavior.

runSetup.name: MinCallbacksPerSecond
runSetup.description: The minimum number of callbacks per second.

runSetup.name: RealTimeClock
runSetup.description: Whether to run the simulation using the real-time clock.

runSetup.name: RiskAnalysisConcurrentReplicationLimit
runSetup.description: The maximum number of risk analysis replications that may run concurrently. Zero means no limit.

runSetup.name: RiskAnalysisConfidenceLevel
runSetup.description: The confidence interval level used for risk analysis statistics.

allowedValueDescriptions.description: Do not calculate a confidence interval.
Use a 90% confidence level.
Use a 95% confidence level.
Use a 98% confidence level.
Use a 99% confidence level.
Use the default confidence level.

runSetup.name: RiskAnalysisNumberOfReplications
runSetup.description: The number of replications used for risk analysis.

runSetup.name: RunEndType
runSetup.description: The method used to determine the ending time of the simulation.

allowedValueDescriptions.description: The simulation run will end when it runs out of calendar events.
Use a specific ending date and time.
Use a specific run length to determine the ending time.

runSetup.name: RunStartCurrentTimeType
runSetup.description: When RunStartType is UseCurrent, the precision at which the current time is truncated.

allowedValueDescriptions.description: Use the current time with milliseconds removed.
Use the current time with seconds and milliseconds removed.
Use the current time with minutes, seconds, and milliseconds removed.
Use midnight at the start of the current day.
Use midnight at the start of the current week.
Use midnight at the start of the current month.
Use midnight at the start of the current year.

runSetup.name: RunStartCurrentTimeZoneId
runSetup.description: The time zone ID used when calculating a current-time start. Leave empty to use the local time zone.

runSetup.name: RunStartType
runSetup.description: The lower-level starting-time mode. Use Specific to use StartTime or UseCurrent to calculate the start from the current time.

allowedValueDescriptions.description: Use the configured StartTime.
Use the current date and time, optionally truncated according to RunStartCurrentTimeType.

runSetup.name: SpecificReplicationNumber
runSetup.description: The specific replication number to run when a specific replication is selected.

runSetup.name: StartTime
runSetup.description: The starting time of the simulation when StartTimeType is Specific.

runSetup.name: StartTimeType
runSetup.description: The method used to determine the starting time of the simulation. Prefer this high-level setting over the lower-level RunStartType and RunStartCurrentTimeType settings.

allowedValueDescriptions.description: Use a specific date and time.
Use the current date and time truncated to the second.
Use the current date and time truncated to the minute.
Use the current date and time truncated to the hour.
Use the current date and time truncated to the beginning of the day.
Use the current date and time truncated to the beginning of the week.
Use the current date and time truncated to the beginning of the month.
Use the current date and time truncated to the beginning of the year.

runSetup.name: StopAtEndOfRun
runSetup.description: Whether to stop the model at the end of the run.

runSetup.name: UpdateInterval
runSetup.description: The update interval, expressed in UpdateIntervalTimeUnit.

runSetup.name: UpdateIntervalHours
runSetup.description: The effective UpdateInterval converted to hours. This value is read-only.

runSetup.name: UpdateIntervalTimeUnit
runSetup.description: The time unit subtype used by UpdateInterval.

runSetup.name: WarningNotificationLevel
runSetup.description: The notification level for runtime warnings.

allowedValueDescriptions.description: Do not report runtime warnings.
Report runtime warnings only to the trace.
Show runtime warnings in a popup.
Report runtime warnings as runtime errors.

compatibilitySettings.name: AllChangeoverLogicExpressionEvaluationsAllowResourceReferences
compatibilitySettings.displayName: All Changeover Logic Expression Evaluations Allow Resource References
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether all expression evaluations by a Changeover Logic element allow references to the resource. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AllowCrossNodeComparisonsWhenUsingRoutingGroupDynamicSelectionRules
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Allow Cross-Node Comparisons When Using Routing Group Dynamic Selection Rules
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether routing groups are allowed to compare dynamic selection rule results across destination nodes, in order to determine the best overall entity destination assignments. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AllowExplicitRowSelectionsOfPreviouslyRowSelectedTablesWithoutActiveDetailSelections
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Allow Explicit Row Selections Of Previously Row Selected Tables Without Active Detail Selections
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether a reference of DetailTable[Index] is evaluated in the context of the current row subset for that detail table when being evaluated as part of an expression as a result of a previous reference to DetailTable[OtherIndex]. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AllowIndexingPastRelatedRowsForTableStateIndexing
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Allow Indexing Past Related Rows For Table State Indexing
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is True, when explicitly indexing into a table to get a table state value (in the form TableName[index].TableState) if the table has foreign keys into a master table for which the table selections have a row set, and the specified index goes beyond the set of 'detail' rows for that selection, then the index will instead be used to as a raw index into the overall table, instead of a runtime error being thrown. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: AllowRouteRequestQueueBypassing
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Allow Route Request Queue Bypassing
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether an entity executing a Route step is allowed to immediately be assigned a destination node bypassing the route request queue. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: AllowTokenBasedTableRowReferencesInQueueRankingExpressions
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Allow Token-Based Table Row References In Queue Ranking Expressions
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether table row references set for process tokens are allowed in queue ranking expressions. For example, whether table row references set for process tokens executing Seize steps are allowed in the resource Ranking Expression properties used to rank allocation queue items. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysAllocateResourcesToFirstEligibleSeizeRequests
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Allocate Resources To First Eligible Seize Requests
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to always allocate a resource's available capacity to the first eligible seize request(s) waiting in its allocation queue. If this setting is False and no dynamic selection rule is being used, then a resource will be unable to continue further checking of seize requests waiting in its allocation queue if the seize request at the front of the queue is ineligible. The recommended value for this setting is True so that further checking is allowed.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysAllowInfinityAsLinkSelectionWeightValue
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Allow 'Infinity' As Link Selection Weight Value
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether 'Infinity' is always allowed as a possible value for a link selection weight. To ensure safe evaluation of link selection weight values by the simulation engine, the recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysAssociateDynamicSelectionRuleEvaluationsWithTheObjectsMakingTheSelections
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Associate Dynamic Selection Rule Evaluations With The Objects Making The Selections
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether expression evaluations when using a dynamic selection rule are always associated with the objects making the selections. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysCheckSpecificRunSpaceContextWhenResolvingTableRowReferences
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Check Specific Run Space Context When Resolving Table Row References
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the specific run space context is always checked when resolving table row references. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysConsiderParentTokenTableRowReferencesWhenResolvingRowCountsInSearchStep
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Consider Parent Token Table Row References When Resolving Row Counts In Search Step
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to consider the parent token's table row references when resolving Search step expressions involving table row counts. This setting could affect the output of table expressions such as AvailableRowCount and RandomValue. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysDoFullChecksOfBatchLogicParentQueues
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Do Full Checks Of Batch Logic Parent Queues
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is False, then a batch logic element will stop further checking of entities waiting in its parent queue if the entity waiting at the front of the queue cannot collect its required batch quantity. The recommended value for this setting is True so that further checking is always allowed.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysThrowIfSetSequenceTableRowReferenceError
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Throw If Set Sequence Table Row Reference Error
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to always throw a runtime error if an exception occurs when setting a sequence table row reference. The recommended value for this setting is True. Otherwise, such exceptions may be silently ignored causing skipped SetRow steps that are difficult to detect and diagnose.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysTryImmediatelyAllocateMaterial
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Try Immediately Allocate Material
compatibilitySettings.description: When executing a Produce step, indicates whether to ignore the step's Immediate Try Allocate property setting and always assume True. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysTryImmediatelyConsumeMaterial
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Try Immediately Consume Material
compatibilitySettings.description: When executing a Consume step, indicates whether to ignore the step's Immediate Try Consume property setting and always assume True. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysUsePropertyParentTableReferences
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Use Property Parent Table References
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the table row references of a property's parent object should always be considered when resolving the property's value. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AlwaysUseSeizeSelectionGoalWhenCheckingResourceAllocationQueue
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Always Use Seize Selection Goal When Checking Resource Allocation Queue
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether a Seize step's selection goal should be used not only at the initial seize attempt but also whenever any resource allocation queue checks occur - if waiting for resources is necessary - regardless of the Must Simultaneous Seize option setting. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AnimationOfActiveAgentsShouldPreventRunEnding
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Animation of Active Agents Should Prevent Run Ending
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates if animation of active agents in the system should prevent a run from stopping when the end time of the run is unspecified. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: AssumeInputNodeEntriesAreToAssociatedObjectIfNoDrawnOutboundLinks
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Assume Input Node Entries Are To Associated Object If No Drawn Outbound Links
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is set to True, then if an entity is entering a node with no drawn outbound links and that node is an external input node to enter another object, the engine will assume the entity's objective is to enter the input node's associated object and thus execute the node's standard 'OnEnteredToAssociatedObject' process (if specified). The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AutoCancelMoveRequestIfResourceReleased
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Auto Cancel Move Request If Resource Released
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to automatically cancel a resource move request if that resource is released. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: AutoDestroyZeroVolumeEntitiesInContainersWithZeroRateInflow
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Auto Destroy Zero Volume Entities In Containers With Zero Rate Inflow
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is False, entities in a container that fall to zero volume with an existing inflow, where the inflow rate is zero, will not automatically be destroyed. Doing so may constrain upstream flows. The recommended value for this setting is True to remove the potential upstream constraint.

compatibilitySettings.name: AutomaticallyAdjustTimerTargetTriggeringEventCountIfZeroToOne
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Automatically Adjust Timer's Target Triggering Event Count If Zero To One
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is True, and an event count-based timer's Triggering Event Count expression property has returned the value zero, then the target triggering event count for that timer will be automatically adjusted to one. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: AutomaticallyClearEntityDestinationNodeFirstBeforeExecutingRouteStep
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Automatically Clear Entity Destination Node First Before Executing Route Step
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to automatically clear an entity's reference to a destination node first before executing a Route step.

compatibilitySettings.name: AutomaticNetworkPathExistenceChecksForVisitRequests
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Automatic Network Path Existence Checks For Visit Requests
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether automatic network path existence checks for visit requests are enabled if a transporter or moveable resource's travel mode is Network Only. The recommended value for this setting is False to allow for possible travel mode assignments, network assignments, or shortest path updates.

compatibilitySettings.name: ChangeNaNToZeroInExpressions
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Automatically Return Zero Instead of NaN In Expressions
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is set to True, then for any element or state function with no parameters that is used in an expression, the engine will automatically adjust a NaN result returned by the function to zero. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: DefaultListStateResultsClassificationDataItemString
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Default List State Results Classification Data Item String
compatibilitySettings.description:
The default string used as the Data Item field for classifying results reported by list states in the model. 

Note that you may insert a state value label into the Data Item classification string by using the special parameter '$(StateValueLabel)'. When a list state is reporting statistics for an individual state value, if that parameter occurs within the Data Item classification string then it will be replaced with the actual state value label.

compatibilitySettings.name: DontUnitConvertStateParameters
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Do Not Perform Unit Conversions For State Parameters
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is set to True, then the engine will not properly handle unit conversions of state parameters such the Weight or Volume parameters of a queue that is holding entities. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: EnsureForeignNodesCastToNonNodeTypesAreAssociatedNodes
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Ensure Foreign Nodes Cast To Non Node Types Are Associated Nodes
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is set to True, then the engine will throw a runtime error if a node is referenced via the Foreign/Candidate/Owner keywords, the cast given is not a Node type, and the node is not associated with an object as an external input or output node. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: EvaluateExpressionFunctionsInExpressionsUsingUnitTypesOfExpression
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Evaluate Expression Functions In Expressions Using Units Of Expression
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether expression functions used in expressions will be evaluated using the units specified for the expression itself. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: ExcludeEntitiesTransferringOutOfChildStationsFromResourceUtilization
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Exclude Entities Transferring Out Of Child Stations From Resource Utilization
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether capacity allocated to entities transferring out of child station locations of a resource are excluded from that resource's utilization calculations if the utilization type of the resource's Blocked state is NotUtilized. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: ExcludeUnrelatedRowsInTimerArrivalTables
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Exclude Unrelated Rows In Timer Arrival Tables
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to exclude unrelated rows if an arrival table used to schedule timer events has primary key/foreign key relationships. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: HarvestAvailableRowsViaUnionAcrossAllRowsReferencedFromOriginalTable
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Harvest Available Rows Via Union Across All Rows Referenced From Original Table
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether calculation of available rows will result from the union of all row relations into an tables referenced via foreign key from the table explicitly selected. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: IgnorePrimaryForeignKeyRelationshipsWhenEvaluatingTablePropertyRandomRowFunction
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Ignore Primary-Foreign Key Relationships When Evaluating Table Property 'RandomRow' Function
compatibilitySettings.description: If using TableName.PropertyName.RandomRow function syntax in an expression and this setting is set to True, then the value returned by the RandomRow function will ignore any foreign-primary key relationships and always return a random row index into the entire table, regardless of whether or not the active token or object is referencing a row selection set in the table.

compatibilitySettings.name: IgnoreShortCircuitEvaluationInExpressions
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Ignore Short Circuit Evaluation In Expressions
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is set to True, then Simio will not 'short circuit' evaluation of expressions using && or || in them. For example, 'MyRefState != Nothing && Random.Uniform(MyRefState.MyEntity.MyState, 100) < 5' will normally 'short circuit' evaluation if it sees that MyRefState is Nothing, and will not evaluate the latter part of the && statement. If this setting is True, then Simio will evaluate both parts no matter what.

compatibilitySettings.name: IgnoreTableReferencesWhenResolvingScheduleExceptions
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Ignore Table References When Resolving Schedule Exceptions
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates if, when resolving the exception repeat groups for a work schedule on a resource, the table references set on the resource will be ignored. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: IgnoreTableReferencesWhenResolvingTableStatesIndexedByRow
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Ignore Table References When Resolving Table States Indexed By Row
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates when resolving table states in the form TableName[RowNumber].StateName that existing table references on the object should be ignored. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: IncludeContextObjectInTableReferenceSearches
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Include Context Object In Table Reference Searches
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether, when resolving a table reference, references held by the active token's context object will be included in the search. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: IncludeMaterialOrInventoryInMaterialUsageLogExpressionEvaluations
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Include Material Or Inventory In Material Usage Log Expression Evaluations
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to include the Material or Inventory element in Material Usage Log expression evaluations. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: IncludeStaticAgentObjectInTableReferenceSearches
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Include Static Agent Object In Table Reference Searches
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether, when resolving a table reference, references held by the associated object's static instance (if the object is an agent) will be included in the search. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: IncludeTallyStatisticInTallyObservationLogExpressionEvaluations
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Include Tally Statistic In Tally Observation Log Expression Evaluations
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to include the Tally Statistic element in Tally Observation Log expression evaluations. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: IncludeTokenInTallyObservationLogExpressionEvaluations
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Include Token In Tally Observation Log Expression Evaluations
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to include the token executing the Tally step in Tally Observation Log expression evaluations. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: MaxExpressionStackSize
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Maximum Expression Stack Size
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates the size of the stack of expressions to evaluate before throwing a runtime error. For example, if expression A calls into expression B, which calls into expression C, a stack size of at least 3 would be necessary.

compatibilitySettings.name: MinimalAutomaticRouteRequestQueueChecking
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Minimal Automatic Route Request Queue Checking
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether routing groups will automatically check their route request queues only when space at a possible destination node has become available or when a planned or unplanned primary resource downtime has ended. Otherwise, if this setting is False, then routing groups will automatically check their route request queues when any station or resource state change occurs at a possible destination node, resulting in a greater number of automatic (and likely unnecessary) route request queue checks. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: NodeAssociatedStationHasSpaceForFunctionConsidersAllPossibleRedirectStations
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Node.AssociatedStationHasSpaceFor() Function Considers All Possible Redirect Stations
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the AssociatedStationHasSpaceFor() function provided by an external input node considers all possible redirect stations in addition to the node's most immediate associated station location. For example, if the node is the input node of a server with an input buffer, this setting determines whether that node's AssociatedStationHasSpaceFor() function considers space in both the input buffer and processing station locations of that server or only in its input buffer. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: OnReleasedProcessCompatibilityMode
compatibilitySettings.displayName: On Released Process Compatibility Mode
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to execute an On Released Process of a Release step using token associated object and token context object references that are compatible with Simio version Sprint 190 or earlier.

compatibilitySettings.name: OnSeizedProcessCompatibilityMode
compatibilitySettings.displayName: On Seized Process Compatibility Mode
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to execute an On Seized Process of a Seize step using token associated object and token context object references that are compatible with Simio version Sprint 190 or earlier.

compatibilitySettings.name: PreventMonitorTriggeringDuringStateInitialization
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Prevent Monitor Triggering During State Initialization
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether monitors in the model will be prevented from triggering during the value initialization of their monitored state variables. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: RecordStateVariableValueWheneverStateStatisticFunctionCalled
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Record State Variable Value Whenever State Statistic Function Called
compatibilitySettings.description: For any State Statistic element, indicates whether to record and log the monitored state variable's current value and parameters whenever one of the state statistic's functions is called (specifically the Average, Minimum, Maximum, LastRecordedValue, or HalfWidth functions). The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: ReportMaterialConsumptionCostAsUsageCostCharged
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Report Material Consumption Cost As Usage Cost Charged
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the total cost charged to consumers of a specific material is reported in the results as 'UsageCostCharged' instead of 'MaterialCostCharged'. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: ReserveBinsQuantSelectionRuleCanAutoCreateStockQuants
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Reserve Bins Quant Selection Rule Can Auto Create Stock Quants
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether a Quant selection rule for a Reserve Bins step can automatically create a new stock quant if no existing quant is selected in a storage bin. The recommended value for this setting is False to enforce that a Quant selection rule explicitly means add to existing stock.

compatibilitySettings.name: RoutingGroupAsContextOnEvaluatingToken
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Routing Group As Context On Evaluating Token
compatibilitySettings.description:
Indicates whether when evaluating the Destination Node List Name and Destination Blocked Condition for a Routing Group Element, if the routing group should be set as the 'context' element for the executing token.The recommended value for this setting is True.

NOTE: This setting is not applicable and is ignored if the Always Use Property Parent Table References advanced compatibility setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: RunOnEvaluatingRouteRequestAsRegularProcess
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Run OnEvaluatingRouteRequest As A Regular Process
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the OnEvaluatingRouteRequest process of a RoutingGroup element is executed as a 'regular' process instead of a 'decision' process. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: RunResourceOnCapacityAllocatedProcessAfterSeizeStepOnSeizedProcess
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Run Resource OnCapacityAllocated Process After Seize Step On Seized Process
compatibilitySettings.description: When a resource is seized, indicates whether the resource's OnCapacityAllocated process is executed after the On Seized Process optionally specified by the Seize step. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: RunResourceOnCapacityReleasedProcessAfterReleaseStepOnReleasedProcess
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Run Resource OnCapacityReleased Process After Release Step On Released Process
compatibilitySettings.description: When a resource is released, indicates whether the resource's OnCapacityReleased process is executed after the On Released Process optionally specified by the Release step. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: ScheduleConstraintLogicRelatedQueueChecksAsLatestCurrentEvents
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Schedule Constraint Logic Related Queue Checks As Latest Current Events
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to schedule constraint logic-related queue checks as latest priority current events, thereby allowing queue checks scheduled for any other reasons to happen first. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: ScheduleLateCurrentEventToTryAllocatingWhenResourceCapacityIncreased
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Schedule Late Current Event To Try Allocating When Resource Capacity Increased
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to schedule a late priority current event to try allocating whenever the capacity of a resource has been increased. Otherwise, allocation will be immediately attempted before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: ScheduleLateCurrentEventToTryBatchingWhenBatchQueueItemInserted
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Schedule Late Current Event To Try Batching When Batch Queue Item Inserted
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to schedule a late priority current event to try batching whenever a new item has been inserted into the parent or member queue of a batch logic element. Otherwise, batching will be immediately attempted before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: SearchAssociatedObjectsOfCandidateObjectsForTableReferences
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Search Associated Objects Of Candidate Objects For Table References
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is True, when using table references in the form Candidate.TableName (such as Candidate.TableName.ColumnName), if the Candidate object has an Associated object, such as the Input Node of a Server having an associated Server object, then that associated objects table references will also be used to find a value if the value isn't found using the Candidates table references. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: SearchCopiesTableReferencesWhenSearchedTableIsImplicitlyReferenced
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Search Step Copies Over Table Row References When Searched Table Is Implicitly Referenced
compatibilitySettings.description:
If this setting is True, when a Search step is used to search a table with rows that are only implicitly referenced by the incoming token to the Search step (for example, searching a 'detail' table of a master-detail relationship with the reference to the 'master' table is already set on the incoming token), then all table references on the incoming token will be copied to the 'found' token. If this setting is False, then those references will not be copied in that case.

NOTE: This setting is not applicable and is ignored if the Search Step Uses Explicit Copy Over Table Row References advanced compatibility setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: SearchRelatedRowsOnlyOptionAlwaysLooksForBestForeignKeyRelationship
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Search Related Rows Only Option Always Looks For Best Foreign Key Relationship
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the Search Related Rows Only option of a Search step always looks for the best foreign key relationship in the searched table. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: SearchStepUsesExplicitCopyOverTableRowReferences
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Search Step Uses Explicit Copy Over Table Row References
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the copying of table row references over from an original token executing a Search step to new tokens associated with found items is based solely on the step's Copy Over Table Row References property value, removing all restrictions that were required by previous Simio versions. Enabling this option also ensures that the table row references for the original token are always included in match condition and search expression evaluations. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: SetCurrentJobStepWhenSettingRowOnSequenceDestinationTable
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Set CurrentJobStep When Setting Row On Sequence Destination Table
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates if, when executing a SetRow on table, and that table contains sequence destinations, and a previous table selection was made with foreign keys into that table, if the CurrentJobStep should be set to the row indicated in the SetRow step. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: TableRowReferencesScopedToParent
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Table Row References Scoped To Parent Instance
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether row references via SetRow or AddRow are differentiated by the parent object instance of the table, if any. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: TableRowRuntimeRemovalClearsReferenceToRow
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Table Row Runtime Removal Clears Reference To Row
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether after a RemoveRows step with the 'RemoveActiveRow' type is executed, the reference to that active row is removed from the given table references. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: ThrowErrorIfIndexOutOfRangeWhenEvaluatingAnItemAtIndexFunction
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Throw Error If Index Out Of Range When Evaluating An 'ItemAtIndex' Function
compatibilitySettings.description: If using Collection.ItemAtIndex(index) function syntax in an expression and this setting is set to True, then when evaluating the function a runtime error will be thrown if the index argument is out of range. Otherwise, an undefined or null value will be returned without any error. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: TimeIndexedRowFunctionReturnsOneInsteadOfZeroIfNoRows
compatibilitySettings.displayName: TimeIndexedRow Function Of Time-Indexed Table Returns One Instead Of Zero If No Rows
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the TimeIndexedRow function of a time-indexed table returns one instead of zero if no rows are found in the table. The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: TokenIsSuspendedFunctionConsidersOnlySuspensionsAppliedExplicitlyToTheToken
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Token.IsSuspended Function Considers Only Suspensions Applied Explicitly To The Token
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether the IsSuspended function provided by a token considers only suspensions applied explicitly to the token, not any suspensions applied to the token's parent process.The recommended value for this setting is False.

compatibilitySettings.name: TreatStockConstraintReservationRequestsAsDemand
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Treat Stock Constraint Reservation Requests As Demand
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether stock constraint reservation requests are treated as material demand orders that affect inventory position and demand fill rates. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: UseConsistentTableReferenceSearches
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Use Consistent Table Reference Searches
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates how, when resolving a table reference, multiple references in the context will be searched. If true, then the object or element containing the property that is referencing the table will be searched first, then the active token, then the active token's associated object, then the active token's context object (if including the context object in the search). The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: UseDoubleStorageForDateTimeStates
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Use Double Precision Storage For DateTime States
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates if DateTime states should internally use double precision floating point, or integer ticks for value storage. Using double precision storage more closely aligns with how other time is handled in the simulation engine. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: UseExecutingTokenToEvaluateRouteStepSelectionConditionExpression
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Use Executing Token To Evaluate Route Step Selection Condition Expression
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to evaluate the Selection Condition expression property of a Route step using the executing token. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: UsePerformanceOptimizedSteps
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Use Performance-Optimized Steps
compatibilitySettings.description: If this setting is True, then at runtime Simio will attempt to use performance-tuned versions of certain steps where possible. The recommended value for this setting is True.

compatibilitySettings.name: UseProcessElementTableRowReferences
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Use Process Element Table Row References
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to use a Process Element's table row references when retrieving property values.

compatibilitySettings.name: UseStartTasksAssociatedObjectCurrentLocationAsContextForTaskPropertyEvaluations
compatibilitySettings.displayName: Use Start Tasks Associated Object Current Location As Context For Task Property Evaluations
compatibilitySettings.description: Indicates whether to use the current location of the Start Tasks step's associated object as the context for task property evaluations. The recommended value for this setting is True. Otherwise, the Task Sequence element's parent object will be used as the context.
